Overview.Name: Sathyagama Abhinav Kumar
Overview.Food_Habit: I can eat one bite and stop
Overview.Goal: Looking better (appearance), Feeling energetic & confident, Mental wellbeing & stress reduction

Meal_1 (Main Meal): Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & egg curry (2–3 eggs) & vegetable curry + curd
Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & paneer curry (100 g) & vegetable curry
Option 3: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & curd (200 g) & vegetable curry
Meal_2 (Dinner - lighter): Option 2: Paneer cubes (120 g) + cooked vegetables

Notes_and_Tips: Avoid ordering food online and stick to simple home cooked meals.
Start meals with eggs, paneer or curd before eating rice.
For stress or boredom eating, drink buttermilk or water and wait 10 minutes.
Keep dinner light to support fat loss and digestion.
Maintain fixed meal timing daily to improve consistency and results.
